hook: Stay ahead of tech trends with an AI that learns as you do.
body: Introducing Hermes Agent by NousResearch, a personal tech assistant that evolves alongside your skills and projects. Built for developers and creators, it adapts to your needs, suggesting improvements or automating tasks based on your coding patterns. This isn’t just another chatbot; it’s a co-pilot for innovation.
cta: Clone the repo now and let Hermes Agent be your tech butler.
